english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent, often before 都 to say that something is true worldwide.
Use this when something applies across the entire world rather than merely in every local place.

examples.english: People worldwide are watching this match.
examples.jyutping: cyun4 sai3 gaai3 dou1 tai2 gan2 ni1 coeng4 bo1

examples.english: This company's services are available globally throughout the entire world.
examples.traditional: 呢間公司嘅服務已經遍及全世界。
examples.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 ji5 ging1 pin3 kap6 cyun4 sai3 gaai3
